decisions.evidence: The original Proof 1.1 applied real rational-step density directly to a complex zero extension; i times the indicator of (0,1) is at distance at least one from every real step. The exact supplier Statement has rational coefficients. Facts F5 and Proof 1.1 now use countable D+iD, separate real/imaginary approximations, the explicit squared-norm bound and norm-decreasing restriction. Completeness and the second-linear convention then meet the Segal supplier hypotheses.
